name: Knott's Pemmican Pickle & Park Pickle Carts Giant Whole Dill Pickle (Skin & Seed Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Pemmican Pickle (Ghost Town · Knott's) & Disneyland Fruit Carts
whyItWorks: While salty dill pickle juice is great for heat-exhaustion electrolytes, a giant whole cucumber pickle has thick, waxy insoluble skin and hundreds of seeds that can irritate an active flare.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If craving the salt on a hot park day, sip the pickle brine or eat only the soft inner flesh while leaving the tough dark-green outer skin behind (and never order the Spicy Hot Pickle!).
watchOuts: Tough cucumber skins and seeds; avoid Spicy Chamoy/Hot Pickles completely
